color.summary: White pages with grey ink (#3c3c3c, #4b4b4b on controls), #777777 and #afafaf for quieter text, #e5e5e5 for every border and #f7f7f7 for field fills. Brand colors carry meaning: green #58cc02 is the main action and the logo, blue #1cb0f6 links and selection, red #ff4b4b a wrong answer, purple #ce82ff the New word tag. Dark mode moves to a blue-black #131f24 with #37464f borders, lightens the green to #93d333 and puts dark ink on it.
usage: Each colored button sits on a darker band of its own hue (#58a700 under green, #1899d6 under blue), not on a grey shadow.

type.summary: One rounded family, duolingo-sans: 17px on a 20px line for body text, 19px in answer choices, 32px at 700 for lesson titles. Buttons and small links are 15 to 17px caps at 700 with 0.8px tracking. The marketing headings (duolingo works) switch to the logo's Feather face at 48 to 64px.

shape.summary: Round and soft: 16px corners on the main buttons and dialogs, 12px on fields, outlined buttons and answer tiles, 8px on the small key boxes. The lesson progress bar is a full pill.

spacing.summary: Loose: 16 and 24px are the common gaps, with 30px inside dialogs and 24px inside answer tiles. Buttons and fields are 46 to 48px tall.

elevation.summary: No blurred shadows. Depth is a solid edge under the element: 2px of #e5e5e5 under white buttons and answer tiles, 4px of a darker shade under colored buttons. Pressing a button drops it onto that edge.

button.summary: Chunky caps buttons, 46 to 48px tall, with a solid edge underneath. Green is the main action (Check), blue the next step (Keep going), red the step after a wrong answer (Continue); white outlined ones are the alternatives (Skip, I already have an account, the social sign-ins). The markup names none of them.
